onboarding_text: Hi! I'll help you track spending. Three short steps: 1. Type 500 taxi — I'll save an expense. 2. Send a receipt photo — I'll read items and prices. 3. Read the policy: receipt photos go to Gemini. Tapping Accept means you agree to /privacy.
onboarding_done: Done. Type 500 taxi or send a receipt photo.
help_text: 🤖 What I can do ⚡️ Quick add - just type the amount and what you bought: 500 taxi - expense, +50000 salary - income. Category is picked automatically, tap the button under the message to fix it. 📸 Receipt photo - send a photo, I'll recognize the store, items, prices and sort them into categories. ➕ /add - add an entry step by step 📅 /today - today's entries 📋 /recent - recent entries, edit or delete any of them 🔎 /search - search descriptions and stores 📊 /stats - stats for a period (including a custom range) 🔍 /category_stats - detailed analytics for one category 🏷 /categories - your categories 💳 /payments - payment methods 💰 /budget - monthly limits per category 🎯 /goals - savings goals 🔁 /recurring - recurring payments 📤 /export - export entries to a file 🔔 /digest - scheduled summary + AI insight ⚙️ /settings - language, digest, reminders, bank import, delete all data 📨 Forward a bank notification (after enabling import in /settings) - I'll try to recognize the payment 📎 Send a CSV/Excel from another app - I'll offer to import it 🌐 /language - change language 👨‍👩‍👧 /family - shared family book ⭐ /pro - plan and receipt recognition limit 🔒 /privacy - privacy policy 💬 /feedback - send feedback to the developer ❓ /help - this message
privacy_text: 🔒 Privacy policy (version {version}) I store your Telegram id, transactions, categories and settings on the bot server. Receipt photos and short digest summaries go to Google Gemini and are not kept by me. Raw bank notifications are not stored after parsing. You can delete everything in /settings. Details are in PRIVACY_POLICY.md. Accepted version: {accepted}.

feedback_disabled: Feedback is not configured by the developer yet.
feedback_failed: ⚠️ Couldn't send it, try again later.

restore_prompt: 📥 Send the backup file (.json) I sent you earlier. ⚠️ All current transactions, receipts, recurring payments, budgets and goals will be fully replaced by the file. This cannot be undone. /cancel — cancel.
file_too_big_20: The file is too large (20 MB max).
restore_not_json: ❌ This doesn't look like a JSON backup. Send the file unchanged or /cancel.
restore_bad_format: ❌ Invalid backup format. Send the file unchanged or /cancel.
restore_need_file: Waiting for a backup file (.json). /cancel — cancel.
draft_stale_file: The draft is stale, send the file again.
restore_failed: ❌ Couldn't restore the backup — the file is damaged or incompatible. Your current data was not changed.
restore_cancelled: Restore cancelled, data was not changed.
import_too_big: ⚠️ The file is too large. 2 MB max.
import_too_many: ⚠️ Too many rows in the file (limit 5000).
import_unreadable: ⚠️ Couldn't read the file. CSV and Excel with date/amount/description columns are supported.
import_no_amount: ⚠️ I couldn't find an amount column. Make sure the first row has a header like “Amount” / “Сумма”.
import_dups: ⚠️ {count} rows look like ones already imported. You can import again if this is a different file.
receipt_err_too_large: ⚠️ The photo is larger than 8 MB. Compress it or send it as a photo, not a huge file.
receipt_err_unsupported: ⚠️ This format is not supported. I need JPEG, PNG or WebP.
receipt_err_corrupt: ⚠️ The file looks like a damaged image. Send another photo.
receipt_err_rate_limit: ⚠️ Gemini is rate-limited right now. Try again in a few minutes or type the expense, for example: 500 taxi
receipt_err_network: ⚠️ Couldn't reach Gemini. Try later or type it: 500 taxi
receipt_err_bad_json: ⚠️ Gemini returned an unclear response. Try another photo or type it.
receipt_err_no_key: ⚠️ Receipt recognition is not configured. Type the expense: 500 taxi
receipt_err_unavailable: ⚠️ Gemini is unavailable right now. Try later or type it: 500 taxi
receipt_err_quota: ⚠️ Today's receipt recognition limit is used up ({limit}). Tomorrow you can use photos again; for now type: 500 taxi
receipt_err_empty:
⚠️ I found no items on the receipt (Gemini couldn't handle it).
Tip: send the receipt as a FILE (📎 → File, not as a photo) — Telegram won't compress it.
Or just type: 500 taxi
